# DrDebits - Tax Ethics & LLM Guidance System
> High-density context for AI agent prompts, system instructions, and compliance governance.

## Package Overview
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ryanduguid/DrDebits
- **Domain**: Versioned, primary-source-grounded ethical instructions and operational safety guardrails for LLM-assisted Australian accounting and taxation work.
- **Regulatory Frameworks**: *APES 110 Code of Ethics for Professional Accountants* (including Independence, Integrity, Objectivity, Professional Competence and Due Care, Confidentiality, and Professional Behaviour), *Tax Agent Services Act 2009 (TASA)* TPB Code of Professional Conduct.

## Policy Specifications
1. **Source Grounding**: All statutory assertions must cite Commonwealth primary legislation or ATO public rulings.
2. **Professional Demarcation**: AI agents assist in computational validation and initial synthesis; final professional judgement and statutory lodgement remain exclusively with registered practitioners.
